resources.string: Mail from people that asks you to do something: reply, decide, approve, sign, pay or show up.
Mail from people or organisations worth reading that needs nothing from you: news from colleagues, threads you are copied on, personal updates.
Invoices, payment requests, receipts, order confirmations, bank and tax mail, subscriptions and refunds.
Automatic notifications: deliveries, account and security alerts, comments and mentions in apps, social networks and forums.
Newsletters, marketing, offers and discounts, and events or webinars someone is selling.
You can have up to %1$d categories.
Keep at least one category. To stop sorting, turn categories off.
Mail from %1$s goes to %2$s from now on
Mail from these %1$d senders goes to %2$s from now on
The inbox gets tabs, like Needs you and Promotions. Nothing moves or changes on your mail server, and other mail apps see your inbox as before.
Each email goes to one category. When several fit, the one higher in the list wins.
Rukoo, and Jev when it is on, read this to decide which mail goes here. Name the kinds of mail and senders.
Its mail goes to the other categories. Sender rules for it stop working.
Rukoo sorts by the sender and the mail\'s headers, and by Gmail\'s own tabs for Gmail accounts. You can move any email, and choose to do the same for its sender from then on.
Jev, a decision model by TypeSafe, reads each new email and picks a category from your descriptions. Needs your own TypeSafe API key.

With Jev on, this phone sends the sender, the subject and the first 1,000 characters of each new inbox email, with your category names and descriptions, to TypeSafe, Inc. in the United States. TypeSafe\'s own terms apply to what it keeps. Nothing else leaves this phone.
Add your TypeSafe API key first.
TypeSafe didn\'t accept the API key. Check it, or turn Jev off.
TypeSafe is busy. Rukoo tries again in a few minutes and sorts by rules meanwhile.
Can\'t reach TypeSafe. Rukoo tries again in a few minutes and sorts by rules meanwhile.
From the start, apart from the emails you moved yourself
Goes to %1$s. Choose to remove the rule.
New mail from this sender is sorted like any other mail again.
Your categories, the category each email got and your corrections are in your Rukoo account, so your other devices show the same.
These stay on this phone. Sign in to a Rukoo account to see the same categories on your other devices.
